john.3.p1.b1.text: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews. He came to Jesus at night …

john.3.p1.b2.text: “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”

john.3.p2.b1.text: “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.”

john.3.p2.b2.text: “How can a man be born when he is old?” … “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”

john.3.p3.b1.text: … no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit. … Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’

john.3.p3.b2.text: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”

john.3.p4.b2.text: “You are Israel’s teacher,” … “and you do not understand these things?

john.3.p4.b3.text: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?

john.3.p5.b1.text: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness,

john.3.p5.b2.text: so the Son of Man must be lifted up, that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.

john.3.p6.b1.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son,

john.3.p6.b2.text: that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

john.3.p6.b3.text: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.

john.3.p7.b1.text: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light

john.3.p7.b2.text: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”

john.3.p8.b1.text: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.

john.3.p8.b2.text: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.

john.3.p8.b3.text: Then a dispute arose between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the issue of ceremonial washing.

john.3.p9.b1.text: “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”

john.3.p9.b2.text: “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.

john.3.p9.b3.text: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’

john.3.p10.b1.text: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice.

john.3.p10.b2.text: That joy is mine, and it is now complete.

john.3.p10.b3.text: He must increase; I must decrease.

john.3.p11.b1.text: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth.

john.3.p11.b2.text: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.

john.3.p11.b3.text: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.

john.3.p12.b1.text: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.

john.3.p12.b2.text: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.

john.3.p12.b3.text: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. …
